action text link: Schedule a session

taste.name: One blue means do this
taste.trigger: When a dark, photo-led page needs the visitor to find the purchase
taste.decision: Chose a single blue (#1A8CFF fill, #2480FF text link) reserved for the next step, everything else in four grays, over colour-coded sections or tinted headings
taste.reason: Because when colour only ever means 'act here', the eye finds the action without reading; the same blue on a heading would dilute that promise
evidence: #1A8CFF covers 6% of surface: nav Get course + hero Get course

taste.name: The cost is printed on the button
taste.trigger: When inviting a visitor to spend time before spending money
taste.decision: Chose to put the duration inside the control ("Watch intro 0:30", "30/60 minutes" support) in a muted gray over a bare verb
taste.reason: Because people commit to a known, small cost; an unlabelled 'Watch' could mean 30 seconds or 30 minutes and many will not risk it
evidence: 0:30 set in #B5B9BA-range gray inside the 44px #222426 pill, after a white label
support copy states 30/60 minutes before the link

taste.name: Sections change floor, not lines
taste.trigger: When moving from one content block to the next on a long dark page
taste.decision: Chose a background step (#0C0D0D band to #050505) with no rule between sections, keeping 1px dividers only inside lists (FAQ, footer), over horizontal rules between every section
taste.reason: Because a change of floor tells the reader 'new topic' without adding another line to look at; rules are kept for rows that must be counted
evidence: no divider at the support section edge (mid screenshot)

taste.name: Proof wears a name and a date
taste.trigger: When showing that the course is liked
taste.decision: Chose a moving row of real posts with a 44px avatar, name, verified mark, @handle and date ("Feb 10") over anonymous star ratings or a big satisfaction percentage
taste.reason: Because a quote that can be traced to a person on a day reads as a witness; an unsigned score reads as marketing
evidence: testimonial row under the hero: 14px name #FFFFFF, handle and date #B5B9BA
